name: Stuttgart in a day
description_md:
Stuttgart in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in Germany. The day is anchored in Stuttgart and includes 6 sightseeing stops.

Visitors cover 5.2 km of walking between stops during the trip. The full day lasts about 7.4 hours. Visit time at each stop is included in this duration.
